lines.text_source: [14][80]@"An interminably[01]long span of time as[01]mortals reckon,[02]but a brief twinkling[01]for us..."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"'Tis strange...[02]To meet one's self[01]in this fashion..."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][03][02]"People are sometimes[01]foolish and weak...[02]Sometimes they do the[01]wrong thing...[02]But not everyone is[01]like that!"

lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][03][02]"Mortais sao por vezes fracos e tolidos...[02]Por vezes fazem o errado...[02]Mas nao todos sao desta forma!"
lines.risk_notes: Fou-Lu reconhece fraqueza humana com tons arcaicos; mas nega a totalidade (not everyone). Frase longa; cuidado byte.

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"They that called me[01]here did say much[01]the same as thee."

lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Aqueles que me chamaram aqui disseram muto a mesma coisa que tu."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C6]@"But their deeds did[01]not liveth up to the[01]promise of the[02]flowerly speech[01]their tongues[01]professed![02]They didst seek to[01]use my power to[02]make war upon their[01]fellows, to kill[01]their enemies!"
